items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: so I got Andy Simpkins and Stix Hooper. And we worked up a tremendous trio.

ctx.x: Monday. And I got these two guys. First I started with Red Mitchell and Nick Martinez; and then Red got a chance to do something else that was better, and I got Max Bennett -- so I had those two guys for a while. And the trio, we used to work around whenever we could.

Then I switched drummers, and I had a little set-to with Max Bennett, and all of a sudden I was without my trio. But this guy called me down at the Beach, so I got Andy Simpkins and Stix Hooper. And we worked up a tremendous trio. Andy... Well, you know who they are.
